name: Teen Library Council
what_you_do: Help plan, promote and help out with teen and children's library programs. Help judge writing contests. Help with community outreach projects.
who_can_apply: Teens. The program page does not state an age or grade rule.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Members earn volunteer credit. The number of hours is not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Not stated on the program page. The library's main phone number is 503-644-2197.
notes: The council meets on the first and third Thursdays, 5 to 6 PM, at Beaverton City Library Main. Members must attend meetings and events.
